role: Domain 10 (combined attacks / multi-copy fields), R5-cost: audit fixes, test general cost and combination, recommend
audit: Fixes proposed so far for multi-copy / combined-attack weaknesses: A_t800 (A015; MOVSW crowds, replicated in 1a8ek +0.188, yrx3b +0.181, confirm hi50u threat +0.028 lo>0), lattice undercut fa/f9/mix4 (trade holes, plain-field cost), LS lockstep (multi -0.062), zph/h34 (router self-kill only; field ~0, h34 did not replicate twice), bodycell/D1 (poisoners only), dA (signature counters only). Picked A_t800 as the best-replicated multi-crowd fix and combined it with KP (the only candidate whose confirm passed the pooled gate; it failed only multi -0.013, driven by multiMix-1 = LowKey+Baltika9+ah02 -0.129).

recommendation: promote-candidate: send KPT (A af3bf51a / B b275310b) to confirmation in place of a KP re-confirm. KP passed the pooled gate in ubyb2 and failed only multi (-0.013); KPT keeps KP's field gains (screen +0.040, highest so far; +0.0105 over KP paired) and fixes the composition behind the multi failure (+0.134 over KP, 10/2) without losing vs 2-copy V6-family crowds. Gate risks to check in the confirm: nozombie (A_t800 -0.050 in hi50u) and the strong group (A_t800 same-seed losses on sstrong-5/lead_V6). If nozombie fails, KP alone stays the fallback.
